components.text: The [color=yellow]Cargo Unloader[color] allow to automatically collect the items and the rocket item inside a lander.

[br] [br] How to use : [br] Charge the cargo unloader with energy and place it next to a launchpad or where you expect a lander to be. When a lander is present, the cargo unloader will automatically collect the items and the rocket item inside the lander and transfer them to its inventory. [br] [br] Stats : [br] - Power Consumption : 100 FE per item extracted.
